the GH/IGF1 system has an antiaging action, and that GH actions, body size, growth, and maturation are important in the determination of aging rate in mammals.

the relationship of growth hormone and its actions to aging and life expectancy in mammals.
the role of GH in the determination of aging rates in mice.
the genetic and molecular mechanisms of aging in mammals, and with the roles of GH and other growth-regulatory hormones in the aging process.
